# Leaf Curt

> Official e-commerce store for Leaf Curt 5-in-1 Laundry Detergent Pods in Bangladesh. Premium laundry care, deep stain removal, and long-lasting freshness with Cash on Delivery nationwide.

## Policies

- [Delivery Policy](/checkout): Delivery across all 64 districts of Bangladesh (24-48h inside Dhaka, 48-72h outside Dhaka).
